Name: Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod - Ridgeside Village-Compatible English Translation
Author: MiscMemos
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]
[quote][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]EXPERIMENTAL / UNTESTED RELEASE
[/b]
I do not play Ridgeside Village and have not live-tested this release. It has been checked for the known conflicts between the two mods and [b]is theoretically compatible[/b], but it should be treated as an experimental release.

[b]Please test it first on a new, disposable save.[/b][/size][/color][/quote][line]

>This is an RSV-compatible version of my standalone English localization of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40300]Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod 4.2.0[/url] by [b]MoLiNaiLvMianMianBing[/b]. 

>Please refer to the original mod for the creator's original work and gameplay information, also summarized in this release's included [b]Important Notes and Guide[/b]. The guide was localized from the documentation supplied with the original Chinese mod and edited where necessary to reflect this RSV-compatible release.

>Please refer to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51300]Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod - English Translation[/url] for a description of the English localization and other changes from the original mod.

[b][size=4]>This page covers only the additional changes made for Ridgeside Village compatibility.[/size][/b]
[line]

[size=4][b][font=Arial]Installation: [/font][/b][/size]
[size=4][b][font=Arial]Before installing this mod, remove [u]any [/u][/font][/b][/size][font=Arial][b][size=4][u]other[/u] [i]Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod[/i][/size][/b][/font][size=4][b][font=Arial] package in your Mods folder, including the original Chinese or my English localization version, to avoid compatibility problems. [/font][/b][b][font=Arial]This is a standalone package, not a drop-in patch. If an existing save previously used another version of the LAD Zayne mod, do not assume that save can be safely converted to this release. No automatic save migration will be provided.[/font][/b][/size]

[b][u]Required Dependencies:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.3.2+[/*]
[*]Content Patcher 2.8.0+[/*]
[*]SpaceCore 1.28.4 (latest)[/*]
[*]Central Station 1.7.0 (latest)[/*]
[*]Ridgeside Village 2.5.17 (latest) and its required dependencies[/*]
[/list][heading][line]
Known RSV Compatibility Issues and Fixes[/heading]
This releases addresses [b]two known conflicts[/b] between the LADS Zayne mod and Ridgeside Village.

[list=1]
[*][b]Both mods have an NPC named Zayne.[/b] The original version was incompatible with RSV because both NPCs use the same internal ID (Zayne). This release gives the LAD Zayne his own internal ID so both characters can exist in the same game.[/*]
[*][b]Both mods also use Winter 28 for festival content.[/b] In this release, [b]Ridgeside Village's Winter 28 festival takes precedence[/b]. The Zayne mod's own Winter 28 festival is not loaded, and Zayne is instead added to RSV's festival. However, this package has all of LADS Zayne's Winter 28 festival assets still in place.[/*]
[/list]I found no other known conflicts during a file-level review, but this release has [b]not been live-tested with RSV[/b].
[heading][line]
Experimental Release / Support[/heading]
[list]
[*]If Ridgeside Village later changes something that creates a new collision with this mod, [b]I do not plan to[/b][b] update this compatibility version to accommodate it.[/b][/*]
[/list][list]
[*]If you encounter an issue that appears to be part of the [b]English localization itself[/b]—for example, missing English text or dialogue behaving incorrectly—please report it on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51300]main [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51300]Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod - English Translation page[/url].[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]You are also welcome to post RSV-specific findings here so that other users know about them, but please understand that I may not be able to resolve them.[/*]
[/list][heading][line]
Alternative Community RSV Fork[/heading]
[list]
[*]The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40300]original Chinese mod page[/url] states that a community-modified version of RSV is available which addresses the conflict differently. Please refer to the screenshot on this page and contact [b]MoLiNaiLvMianMianBing[/b] for more information about that version.[/*]
[*]I will [b]not[/b] publish or provide support for an RSV fork which changes Ridgeside Village so that the Zayne mod's own Winter 28 festival takes precedence.[/*]
[*]This release does the reverse: RSV is left intact, and [b]RSV's Winter 28 festival takes precedence[/b].[/*]
[/list]
